label: Shorts / Reels
description: Vertical, mobile-first edits with one clear idea, visually legible captions and a fast payoff.
intent: Deliver one compelling idea quickly; do not confuse speed with noise.
opening: Start with the strongest truthful visual or question; communicate what the clip is about immediately.
editing: One idea per video; keep pacing responsive to speech and subject action; preserve payoff rather than overcutting.
typography: Large concise captions in tested mobile-safe area; highlight one keyword, not every word.
sound: Clear voice, a restrained music bed and selective emphasis.
critique: Is the premise understandable with sound off? Is important content clear on a small phone?

creative_contrast.when: A new idea, action or visual fact arrives
The viewer needs to read, understand or feel something
